title: Schizosaccharomyces pombe as a predictor toxicity tool
author: Álvarez-Herrera, Maisanaba, et al.

steps.title: Thaw and incubate yeast
steps.instruction: Thaw S. pombe cells on agar plates and incubate in a stove for 48 h at 25 °C to initiate growth.

steps.title: Prepare pre‑inoculum
steps.instruction: Transfer a small amount of biomass from the plate into 5 mL YES medium contained in a sterile 25 mL flask.

steps.title: Grow pre‑inoculum to exponential phase
steps.instruction: Culture the pre‑inoculum for at least two generation times (2–3 h) with continuous shaking at 180 rpm in an incubator shaker set to 25 °C.

steps.title: Verify growth and adjust density
steps.instruction: Measure optical density at 595 nm (or count cells) by adding 100 µL to a well of a 96‑well microplate; target OD≈0.08–0.10. If growth time was 8 h dilute the culture in YES 1:4, if 16 h dilute 1:10. Repeat this verification at least twice before the assay.

steps.title: Dilute culture for dose‑response assay
steps.instruction: Dilute the culture to an OD of 0.004 with a final volume of 55 mL in a 250 mL flask.

steps.title: Equilibrate culture before dosing
steps.instruction: Shake the 250 mL flask for 15 min at 180 rpm and 25 °C.

steps.title: Distribute culture into dosing flasks
steps.instruction: Aliquot the culture into ten separate flasks, each containing 5 mL YES medium.

steps.title: Add test compound concentrations
steps.instruction: Leave flask 1 without drug (negative untreated control). Add increasing concentrations of the toxic substance to flasks 2–10, keeping the solvent/dilution constant.

steps.title: Mix dosing flasks
steps.instruction: Shake all ten flasks for 15 min at 180 rpm and 25 °C.

steps.title: Transfer aliquots to 96‑well plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL from each flask to a 96‑well plate: column 1 receives YES (blank), column 2 receives flask 1, column 3 flask 2, … column 10 flask 9. Fill edge wells with YES or distilled water to maintain humidity.

steps.title: Incubate plate for exposure
steps.instruction: Place the plate on a plate shaker set to 1200 rpm, 25 °C, and agitate continuously for 16 h in a humidity chamber.

steps.title: Measure optical density post‑exposure
steps.instruction: After 16 h, read the density of each well spectrophotometrically using a Varioskan Flash microplate reader.

steps.title: Replicate assay and analyze data
steps.instruction: Repeat the entire dose‑response experiment at least three times. Perform quantitative analysis, compare each experimental group statistically to the untreated control, and generate a dose‑response regression curve with Excel or equivalent software.

steps.title: Select inhibitory concentrations for mechanism study
steps.instruction: From the dose‑response results, choose two concentrations that give ~20–50 % growth inhibition (e.g., EC50 and EC80) for further mechanistic investigation.

steps.title: Prepare mutant and wild‑type cultures
steps.instruction: Select the required defective mutant strains (e.g., mph1Δ, pmk1Δ, sty1Δ, rad3Δ, MDR‑sup, pap1Δ, bfr1Δ, pmd1Δ, mfs1Δ, caf5Δ) and the wild‑type strain. For each, repeat the pre‑inoculum preparation and grow to exponential phase as described in steps 2–3.

steps.title: Dilute cultures to assay density
steps.instruction: Determine OD of each strain and dilute to an OD of 0.004, adjusting to a final volume of 18 mL in a 100 mL flask for each strain.

steps.title: Equilibrate cultures before dosing
steps.instruction: Shake each 100 mL flask for 15 min at 180 rpm and 25 °C.

steps.title: Split cultures into control and two concentration flasks
steps.instruction: For each strain, distribute the 18 mL culture into three 5 mL flasks: (i) no drug (negative control), (ii) concentration 1 (C1) of the selected toxicant, (iii) concentration 2 (C2). Perform the same for the wild‑type and all selected mutants.

steps.title: Mix flasks after dosing
steps.instruction: Shake all flasks for 15 min at 180 rpm and 25 °C.

steps.title: Load plate with mutant and wild‑type samples
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL from each flask to a 96‑well plate in the following order (triplicate): column 1 YES (blank), column 2 wild‑type, column 3 wild‑type + C1, column 4 wild‑type + C2, then repeat the pattern for each mutant strain. Fill edge wells with YES or distilled water.

steps.title: Incubate plate for exposure (mechanism)
steps.instruction: Agitate the plate at 1200 rpm, 25 °C, for 16 h in a humidity chamber.

steps.title: Measure optical density post‑exposure (mechanism)
steps.instruction: After the 16 h exposure, measure the OD of each well spectrophotometrically.

steps.title: Perform statistical analysis and regression
steps.instruction: Analyze the OD data, compare each experimental group statistically to its untreated control, and create dose‑response regression curves (e.g., in Excel) for the mechanistic study.
